sentences.en: Good morning, faculty, friends, and most importantly, the graduate class of 2026.
sentences.zh: 早上好 老师 朋友们 最重要的是 2026年的研究生班

sentences.en: >> [cheering] [applause] >> I'm not going to be long because I know you guys are hungry cuz I'm hungry as hell.
sentences.zh: [欢呼声] [掌声] '我不会很久 因为我知道你们饿了 因为我饿了

sentences.en: I was tricked. I was bamboozled this morning.
sentences.zh: 我被骗了 今天早上我被骗了

sentences.en: They told me to arrive at 7:30, and 3 hours later, I received something I had nothing in it.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我7: 30到达, 3小时后, 我收到的东西,我什么都没有。

sentences.en: Last time I sat this long was I was sitting on the toilet after I had some bad chimichangas from TJ Ribs.
sentences.zh: 上次我坐了这么长时间 是在厕所里 吃了TJ瑞布斯的坏辣椒之后

sentences.en: As I look into the audience today, I see a lot of youngsters, and I consider myself a old man, so youngsters, this is for you.
sentences.zh: 当我看今天的观众, 我看到了很多年轻人, 我认为自己是老人, 所以年轻人,这是给你的。

sentences.en: Uh first, I want to say what your parents would say. I would I would say, "Son, I'm proud of you."
sentences.zh: 首先,我想告诉你父母会怎么说 我会说,"儿子,我为你感到骄傲"

sentences.en: I would say, "Daughter, I'm proud of you."
sentences.zh: 我会说,"亲爱的,我为你感到骄傲。"

sentences.en: And to all the old people receiving masters and doctorates, such as myself, "Sir, I'm proud of you."
sentences.zh: 给所有老人 接受硕士和博士学位,比如我, "先生,我为你感到骄傲。"

sentences.en: "And ma'am, I'm proud of you." Youngsters, I want to leave you with five things. One, never stop learning.
sentences.zh: "女士,我以你为荣" 年轻人,我想给你5件东西

sentences.en: I'm proud of you all today, but this is not the end of your journey. Make sure you continue. Continue to strive.
sentences.zh: 今天我为你们感到骄傲,但这不是你们旅程的终点。请务必继续。继续努力。

sentences.en: Continue to learn. Continue to have fun, and continue to eat Chocolicious gummies at your local 7-Eleven and all the other stores.
sentences.zh: 继续学习 继续玩乐 继续吃七爱尔文和其他地方的香肠

sentences.en: And for all the old people, I see you. Man up.
sentences.zh: 对于所有老人来说,我看见你了。

sentences.en: Number two, youngsters, before you succeed, you must first learn to fail.
sentences.zh: 第二 年轻人 在你成功之前 你必须先学会失败

sentences.en: In the words of the great Shaquille O'Neal, use failure as motivation.
sentences.zh: 用伟大的Shaquille O'Neal的话来说,把失败作为动机。

sentences.en: It's a small percentage of people that accomplish things on the first try.
sentences.zh: 只有一小部分人第一次尝试就完成了

sentences.en: Most of us regular people have to go again, and again. So again, before you succeed, you must first learn to fail. Three, your character will take you further
sentences.zh: 我们大多数常客必须一次又一次地去。所以再次,在你成功之前,你必须先学会失败。第三,你的性格会更进一步。

sentences.en: than your resume. Continue to be kind. Continue to be humble.
sentences.zh: 继续友善 继续谦卑

sentences.en: >> [applause] >> Continue to help those in need.
sentences.zh: 继续帮助有需要的人。

sentences.en: And continue to tell the baby to stop crying.
sentences.zh: 继续叫孩子别哭了

sentences.en: Number four, stay curious and open-minded around the world around you.
sentences.zh: 第四,保持好奇 和开放的心态 周围的世界你。

sentences.en: This is a weird world we live in. One day, Charles Barkley was fat.
sentences.zh: 我们生活的世界很奇怪 有一天查尔斯・巴克利很胖

sentences.en: The next day, he is skinny. I don't know what happened, but this world is crazy.
sentences.zh: 第二天,他瘦了 我不知道发生了什么,但这个世界太疯狂了

sentences.en: And five, celebrate how far you have come, but keep striving for what's ahead. Speaking of celebration, everybody stand up.
sentences.zh: 第五,庆祝你已经走了多远,但继续努力前进。说到庆祝,大家站起来。

sentences.en: Everybody stand up. All the graduates stand up.
sentences.zh: 所有人都站起来 所有的毕业生都站起来

sentences.en: And I want you to put the number one sign up.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能排名第一。

sentences.en: And when I say 1 2 3, I want the whole arena to say, "We did it." 1 2 3.
sentences.zh: 当我说 1 2 3 时，我希望整个竞技场都说：“我们做到了。” 1 2 3。

sentences.en: I know I know this is Baton Rouge. I know we can get louder than that.
sentences.zh: 我知道我知道这是巴吞鲁日。我知道我们的声音可以更大。

sentences.en: 1 2 3. >> [cheering] >> 1 2 3. 1 2 3. I love you very much.
Thank you for coming out. And LSU still stands for Love Shaq University.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你出来。 LSU 仍然代表爱沙克大学。

sentences.en: Call U Dig It. Thank you very much. I love you.
sentences.zh: 打电话给你挖掘它。非常感谢。我爱你。
